name: Underground Intel
desc: Query the Underground for a profitable mark within 10 LY.

name: Letter of Marque
desc: Spend supply buffer to commission a privateer fleet.

name: Craft Supplies
desc: Convert buffer/fleet supplies into fresh supplies.

name: Designate Rival
desc: Designate the most hostile faction as your Rival. 30-day cooldown to swap.

name: Crusade
desc: Declare formal war on your Rival. 6-month commitment. Zeal cap +50 while active.

name: Deploy Forge Device
desc: Deploy a held campaign Forge device.

name: Alpha Storm
desc: Generate an Alpha Storm enveloping the fleet.
